method: Current source functions evaluated in Node VM with minimal DOM and controlled timers; not browser, runtime or persistence evidence.

results.name: Editing a tail item holds the entire automatic FIFO
Completion while editing does not send an old revision
Save commits revision and resumes FIFO head first
Cancel preserves original text and resumes FIFO
Empty Save keeps edit and all FIFO held
Explicit Send now of another item retains edit hold
Send now cannot claim the currently edited item
Duplicate Send now and duplicate claim are no-ops
Stale Edit action after claim cannot create an orphan edit
Stale textarea after closing the edit is a safe no-op
Stale textarea does not mutate a reopened revision of the same ID
Stale Save after reopen same ID cannot commit or clear the new edit
Stale Cancel after reopen same ID preserves the new edit
Inactive conversation Save mutates only its owner
Inactive Send now appends only to captured conversation
Stop holds ordinary Send; hint correctly directs to explicit Now
Paused Send now resumes the existing turn and retains remainder
CtrlEnter Save stops propagation; IME composition cannot save
